data.body: Implementation for scheduled public deprecation removals is complete in Gerrit change 2605 (current patch set 6, commit 5f6dbbec5bdc). Local validation passed: held-out deprecation oracle, focused suites, make lint, make typecheck, and sanitized full make test. LLM-Review is satisfied. Verified is currently blocked by an unrelated scanner-integration lane failure on the current main CI workflow: `python scripts/install_review_scanners.py ...` installs Semgrep into `.tools/review-scanners/semgrep-venv/bin/semgrep` but `make scanner-integration` then reports `ERROR: could not execute .tools/review-scanners/bin/semgrep`. This is outside the ticket file impact and not caused by the deprecation changes; no force/bypass used.
